mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, s.id AS latest_session_id, p.status, p.create_time, CASE WHEN p.update_time >= s.update_time THEN p.update_time ELSE s.update_time END AS update_time, p.create_by, p.update_by FROM yak_project p JOIN ( SELECT id, project_id, update_time FROM ( SELECT id, project_id, update_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC ) AS rn FROM yak_session ) ranked_session WHERE rn = 1 ) s ON s.project_id = p.id ORDER BY update_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yak_project p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM yak_session s WHERE s.project_id = p.id )

SELECT p.id, p.name, s.id AS latest_session_id, p.status, p.create_time, CASE WHEN p.update_time >= s.update_time THEN p.update_time ELSE s.update_time END AS update_time, p.create_by, p.update_by FROM yak_project p JOIN ( SELECT id, project_id, update_time FROM ( SELECT id, project_id, update_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC ) AS rn FROM yak_session WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ) ranked_session WHERE rn = 1 ) s ON s.project_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{projectId}
